caption:
Think you should have it all figured out by now? You never graduate. (1 Timothy 4:6–8 devotional)

We think the teacher is the one who's finished learning. Paul says a good servant is nourished and trained — for life. You never graduate from grace; godliness grows by daily practice, not one insight.
